description.value:
You've become accustomed to controlling multiple machines at the same time with perfect efficiency, your mind being able to process and calculate the positions and velocities of different devices at the same time. You do one of the following.

  • You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Reposition Exocortex] your mine and Reposition Exocortex your turret.

  • You Reposition Exocortex to move your turret and then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Deploy Mine].

  • You Reposition Exocortex your mine and then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Deploy Turret].
